Name: Momma Cat and Kitten
Author: saxamuhphone
Description:
[center][size=4]Ever feel like having one cat in your life just isn't enough? Just add a kitten into the mix! [/size]

There are 5 cat duos using vanilla colors. Both Alternative Textures and Content Patcher versions are available. 



This image was originally created by Nanane and was posted on [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall?iframe_url_utf8=%2FArticleRead.nhn%3Fclubid%3D28468938%26articleid%3D341777]Naver[/url] back in 2022. Regarding permissions, they stated: 

[size=4]"I will upload the file as a PNG, so feel free to make any secondary modifications.
I would appreciate it if you could leave the source when distributing it." [/size]


Note: The addition of a kitten is a just a visual change, no additional functions are added. [/center]
